Select: molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, docs. Join: molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno, compound_records to molecule_dictionary on molregno, docs to compound_records on doc_id. Filter: docs.chembl_id equals 'CHEMBL1126800'. Sort: molecule_chembl_id ascending.
